before.name: c. 2920 BC: Troy is founded on this date (assuming the interpretation of Manfred Korfmann is followed)

after.name: c. 2920 BC: Troy I early settlement; dates vary and earlier remains exist

r2SourceEvidence.review_note: The century overview places the founding at c.2920 under a Korfmann interpretation; the detailed Troy article dates Troy I roughly 3000–2550 BCE and describes earlier Troy 0 material. Turkish Archaeological News also places Troy I c.3000–2550. Changed wording from a precise founding to an early phase reference, and removed political effect. This -2920 slot is not proof of a new foundation in 2920, and does not represent the later Troy of the Trojan War. The coordinate is the archaeological site; the radius is a gameplay value.
r2SourceEvidence.date_precision: One approximate reference for an archaeological phase with disputed endpoints; no event proven in that exact year.
r2SourceEvidence.location_precision: Site coordinate and gameplay radius; the state of any structure in 2920 is not proven.

r2SourceEvidence.review_note: Removed unsupported Egyptian civilization hint for this Anatolian site. Blank is not evidence for any particular polity, and other geographic or ruler fallbacks may still assign civilizations. Existing occupiedStart/-End and city rank were not validated and must not be read as proof of continuous habitation or city status throughout this range.

event.name: c. 2920 BC: One estimate for death of Egyptian ruler Anedjib; dates are debated

r2SourceEvidence.review_note: The century overview gives c.2920 as death but has no separate citation for that specific date; it carries a general citation warning. The ruler biography estimates 8–10 years around c.2930 and discusses discrepant reign lengths; World History Encyclopedia estimates the reign c.2940–2930. No exact year or death location is established. The -2920 game slot records one debated estimate. Abydos Tomb X is a regional reference, not the site of death.
r2SourceEvidence.date_precision: A disputed approximate estimate from a page without a specific citation; not a confirmed exact death date.
r2SourceEvidence.location_precision: Regional tomb-site reference, not a proven death location.
